[FACT] User is exploring new vegan meat alternative brands.  
[PREFERENCE] User loves Upton's Naturals.  
[EVENT] User hosted a dinner party for friends with a fully vegan menu today.  
[EVENT] User's dinner party was a huge success.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on the success of their vegan dinner party.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of popular vegan meat alternative brands: Beyond Meat, Impossible Foods, Quorn, Gardein, Field Roast, Tofurky, Linda McCartney's, Moving Mountains, Oatly's Meat, Good Catch.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that these brands are widely available in the US and can be found in health food stores, specialty grocery stores, or online.  
[PREFERENCE] User is considering trying some of the suggested brands in a vegan stir-fry.  
[PREFERENCE] User is thinking of using broccoli, cauliflower, and sweet potatoes in the stir-fry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided recommendations for vegan-friendly stir-fry sauces: Hoisin sauce, Tamari or Nama shoyu, Nutritional yeast, Sesame oil and ginger, Vegan oyster sauce, Store-bought vegan stir-fry sauces.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a simple recipe for a vegan stir-fry sauce with the following ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamari or nama shoyu, 2 tablespoons rice vinegar, 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast, 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger, 1 teaspoon sesame oil, 1/2 teaspoon garlic, minced, 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes (optional).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested sautéing vegan meat alternatives with oil, garlic, and ginger, then adding the vegetables and stir-fry sauce.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in trying new vegan-friendly cooking techniques like air-frying or pressure cooking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for air-frying: temperature control, not overcrowding, patting dry ingredients, and using oil sparingly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a recipe for Vegan "Chick'n" Nuggets using extra-firm tofu, cornstarch, panko breadcrumbs, lemon juice, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for pressure cooking: liquid ratio, cooking time, natural release, and experimenting with spices.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a recipe for Vegan Lentil Curry with the following ingredients: 1 cup brown or green lentils, 2 cups vegetable broth, 1 onion, 2 cloves garlic, 1 tablespoon curry powder, 1 teaspoon ground cumin,
